movies.description: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

movies.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

movies.description: Framed for his family's murder and left for dead, an ex-hitman will stop at nothing to exact revenge on the masked "demons" who have taken over his city.

movies.description: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

movies.title: Nayyi Navelli (2026) [Hindi]
movies.description: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

movies.title: Lust Stories 3 (2026) [Hindi]
movies.description: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

movies.title: Resident Evil (2026) [Hindi]
movies.description: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

movies.title: Jailer 2 (2026) [Hindi]
movies.description: When a dangerous syndicate expands its reach to threaten his family's peace, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver. Operating from the shadows, he takes on ruthless new enemies to protect his home.

movies.title: Pooja Meri Jaan [Hindi]
movies.description: After Pooja rejects Aniket’s romantic advances, his subsequent death by suicide leaves her facing accusations. As lawyer and friend Sana investigates the circumstances surrounding the incident, questions of obsession, consent, responsibility and the truth behind Pooja’s relationship with Aniket begin to emerge.

movies.title: The Paradise [Hindi]
movies.description: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

movies.title: Sardar 2 [Hindi]
movies.description: When the mysterious Black Dagger threatens national security, Inspector Vijay embarks on his most dangerous mission yet. As the battle unfolds, the extraordinary origin of legendary spy Sardar is finally revealed, uncovering the sacrifices that forged a legend and the secrets that could shape the future.

movies.description: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

movies.title: Gandhari [Hindi]
movies.description: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

movies.title: Babita Singh Reporting [Hindi]
movies.description: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. There, she reunites with her childhood friend Bansi, who is murdered that very night. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.

movies.title: Toxic [Hindi]
movies.description: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

movies.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit [Hindi]
movies.description: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

movies.title: Irumudi [Hindi]
movies.description: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

movies.title: Khalifa: The Ruler [Hindi]
movies.description: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

movies.title: Awarapan 2 [Hindi]
movies.description: Once a feared gangster, Shivam lives hidden away from his past, with no faith left in God or himself. But when fate pulls him into Bangkok's cartel war and forces him back into the darkness he swore never to return to, Shivam must choose what he is willing to live for, when there is nothing left to lose.

movies.title: Ohh My Dog [Hindi]
movies.description: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

movies.title: DC [Hindi]
movies.description: From avenging his mother’s murder to battling police corruption, Das becomes a fugitive after a deadly heist. Amid a trail of bloodshed and loss, he frees Chandra from a life of exploitation, and she gives him a reason to seek a life beyond violence.

movies.title: Karmakhya [Hindi]
movies.description: A mysterious visit to a grieving family pulls a young woman into a terrifying world of secrets, black magic, and haunting illusions. As disturbing events begin to blur the line between reality and nightmare, Kaamakhya finds herself trapped in a chilling chain of events rooted in a dark past that refuses to stay buried.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day [Hindi]
movies.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movies.title: The India Story [Hindi]
movies.description: A community confronts the devastating impact of pesticide contamination as industrial negligence threatens public health. The fight for accountability exposes systemic failures in regulatory oversight and corporate responsibility.

movies.title: Dhamaal 4 [Hindi]
movies.description: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

movies.title: Moana [Hindi]
movies.description: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

movies.title: Baby Do Die Do [Hindi]
movies.description: A deaf and mute serial killer in Mumbai can only hear her dead sister's voice as she commits murders for mysterious reasons.

movies.title: Alpha [Hindi]
movies.description: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

movies.title: Cocktail 2 [Hindi]
movies.description: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

movies.title: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata [Hindi]
movies.description: Inside Cama Hospital, one of the sites targeted during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, nurses, ward boys, cleaners, lift operators, security personnel, and administrative workers keep 400 people alive while armed assailants struck the city around them.

movies.title: Bandar [Hindi]
movies.description: TV star Samar's life spirals when his ex Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks contact with her. Despite his new relationship with Khushi, he faces arrest and encounters a corrupt justice system.

movies.title: The Great Grand Superhero: Aliens Ka Aagman [Hindi]
movies.originalTitle: The Great Grand Superhero: Aliens Ka Aagman [Hindi]
movies.description: Follows a grandfather and grandson whose relationship transforms through the child's imagination when they encounter aliens.

movies.title: Aakhri Sawal [Hindi]
movies.description: Vicky, a brilliant but volatile scholar who ignites a national firestorm when he publicly accuses his legendary mentor, Professor Gopal Nadkarni, of institutional bias. What begins as a faculty dispute is quickly hijacked by a sensationalist news anchor and an ambitious political activist, turning a private disagreement into a televised "intellectual trial" watched by millions.

movies.title: Sacrifice [Hindi]
movies.description: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires, and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

movies.title: Street Fighter (2026) [Hindi]
movies.description: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

movies.title: The End of Oak Street (2026) [Hindi]
movies.description: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

movies.title: Ghamasaan [Hindi]
movies.description: Set in the Hindi heartland, the story follows a cat and mouse chase against a ruthless dacoit. An honest IPS officer is determined to hunt him down, corrupt politicians notwithstanding.

movies.title: Main Ladega [Hindi]
movies.description: A young boy escapes his troubled home, finding solace I in boxing at an army hostel, where he channels his pain into strength to protect his family.

movies.title: Cocaine Bear [Hindi]
movies.description: Inspired by a true story, an oddball group of cops, criminals, tourists and teens converge in a Georgia forest where a 500-pound black bear goes on a murderous rampage after unintentionally ingesting cocaine.

movies.title: Suzume [Hindi]
movies.description: A 17-year-old girl named Suzume helps a mysterious young man close strange doors unleashing disasters across Japan.

movies.title: Paper Lives [Hindi]
movies.description: In the streets of Istanbul, ailing waste warehouse worker Mehmet takes a small boy under his wing and must soon confront his own traumatic childhood.

movies.title: Demon Slayer: Mugen Train [Hindi]
movies.description: Tanjiro Kamado, joined with the Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, board the Infinity Train to investigate a series of mysterious disappearances.

movies.title: Ip Man 4: The Finale [Hindi]
movies.description: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man travels to San Francisco where his student has upset the local martial arts community by opening a Wing Chun school.

movies.title: Miracle in Cell No. 7 [Hindi]
movies.description: Separated from his daughter, a father with an intellectual disability must prove his innocence when he is jailed for the death of a commander's child.

movies.title: The Wandering Earth [Hindi]
movies.description: As the sun begins to expand and threaten Earth, humanity builds giant thrusters to propel the planet out of orbit toward a new star system.

movies.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle [Hindi]
movies.description: Four teenagers in detention discover an old video game console with a game they’ve never heard of. When they decide to play, they are immediately sucked into the jungle world of Jumanji in the bodies of their avatars. They’ll have to complete the adventure of their lives filled with fun, thrills and danger or be stuck in the game forever!

movies.title: Delibal [Hindi]
movies.description: A love story following two young people battling with their emotions and dreams, the pressures of career, family and not knowing what the future holds. Füsun is a brilliant student, destined for a successful career but can't help from falling for Baris, a musician who struggles with a psychological disorder. As the two grow closer they start to adopt each other's traits, but becoming increasingly dependent on one another proves damaging for their relationship.

series.title: You Are My Glory [Hindi]
series.overview: A famous celebrity is about to lose her lucrative video game brand deal. Will her former crush help her become a gaming champion – and might this lead them to romance?

episodes.title: Accidental Encounter
episodes.overview: Jing Jing is the endorser of Honor of Kings, but someone posted a video of how badly she plays. As a result, she must train hard to participate in an entertainment game to prove herself. Yu Tu happens to be playing the game lately and invites Jing Jing to a group battle by mistake.

episodes.title: Contemplation
episodes.overview: Yu Tu is contemplating whether to resign from his work in the research institute. If he works in finance, he can earn four times more than he is making now, but the galaxy is what he aspires to. Meanwhile, Jing Jing devises a plan to get Yu Tu to coach her in Honor of Kings to improve her skills.

episodes.title: We Meet Again
episodes.overview: Jing Jing requests Yu Tu to be her coach but he politely refuses. With continuous training, Jing Jing gets better at the game, surprising even to her manager. Upon finding out that Yu Tu lives in the same city, Jing Jing tricks Yu Tu to go to her house and they finally meet each other.

episodes.title: Training
episodes.overview: Yu Tu finally agrees to be Jing Jing's coach. Yu Tu goes to Jing Jing's place and teaches her how to play the game. They practice all day long to find the right hero for Jing Jing.

episodes.title: A Clean Break
episodes.overview: Yu Tu meets up with Xia Qing and has a clean break with her. Then he attends a class gathering and gets mocked for his career path. Jing Jing helps him to get even.

episodes.title: The Single's Day
episodes.overview: After playing a few matches, Yu Tu picks a few heroes that he thinks are suitable for Qiao Jing Jing's skill level. Meanwhile, Xiao Zhu notices that Yu Tu has started to treat Qiao Jing Jing differently. While playing with other gamers, Yu Tu records the game to help Qiao Jing Jing learn how to analyze the game better.

episodes.title: A Night Out
episodes.overview: After Yu Tu has a somewhat awkward dinner with his friends, he asks if Jing Jing wants to go to a movie. Jing Jing picks a movie, but then realize it might make Yu Tu think of unpleasant memories. And even though they're careful, Jing Jing is still caught on camera by a fan. While Jing Jing and Yu Tu are watching a livestream at her house, Ling arrives with the makeup artists and stylists.

episodes.title: Level Up
episodes.overview: Jing Jing secures a role in a new movie and takes joy in being asked to gain a bit more weight for the role. She decides to introduce Yu Tu to Ling and brings him to Ling's house where he meets her close colleagues for the first time. She also sets a goal to level up in rank in the game.

episodes.title: The First Sight
episodes.overview: Yu Tu sees his teacher and his wife in the restaurant that he and Jing Jing is in, and he invites them to eat with them. The conversation turns sour when his resignation is mentioned, and Yu Tu gets mad at Jing Jing when she defends him. Afterwards, Yu Tu receives an urgent call to go on a business trip to fix a problem with J-X, so they don't see each other for some time.

episodes.title: Salvaging
episodes.overview: Yu Tu and Guan Zai work hard to salvage J-X satellite. As they're going back to their apartment, Guan Zai falls ill and worries about his family. Meanwhile, Yu Tu invites Qiao Jing Jing for games on Honor of Kings.

episodes.title: The Reconciliation
episodes.overview: Yu Tu returns from Xi'an and reconciles with Qiao Jing Jing. Then he takes care of Guan Zai who is admitted to the hospital. Later, when Yu Tu continues to coach Qiao Jing Jing, she finds that he has changed after the trip.

episodes.title: Making Decisions
episodes.overview: Shen Jing is having a hard time coping with Guan Zai's cancer. Yu Tu is staying by Qiao Jing Jing's side to train her, giving her good advice on who to pick for her team. Qiao Jing Jing is surprised when Yu Tu asks her what she wants for her birthday.

episodes.title: Super League
episodes.overview: The Super League begins and the players are divided into two teams of five. After training so hard under Yu Tu, Jing Jing confidently strategize with her chosen teammates. Can Jing Jing and her team win the battle against other professional gamers?

episodes.title: Second Round
episodes.overview: The second round of the competition begins. Which team will win the second round? After the competition is over, Yu Tu feels out of place.

episodes.title: Different Worlds
episodes.overview: On their way back from Super League, Qiao Jing Jing finds out that Yu Tu is going back to work at the research institute. She confesses to Yu Tu. However, he tells her that he will not be seeing her anymore.

episodes.title: Hard to Let Go
episodes.overview: After Yu Tu starts working at the institution again, he manages to lead the team to some success. However, with the original leader Guan Zai gone, his responsibilities increase. In the meantime, Yu Tu's ex-girlfriend comes to Shanghai, while Qiao Jing Jing hasn't been in touch with him.

episodes.title: Walking Down Memory Lane
episodes.overview: Yu Tu visits his parents in Yixing before going on his one-month business trip. He digs out his old computer and reads his old chats with Qiao Jing Jing, reminiscing the past. When taking a walk with his mom, they talk about the old days and his mom’s regrets of discouraging him from doing what he wanted in the past.

episodes.title: Testing
episodes.overview: Yu Tu refuses to join any group activities during the outfield trip. He reads his old chats with Qiao Jing Jing again. Guan Zai calls Yu Tu and his advice inspires Yu Tu to write Jing Jing a letter. The next day, Yu Tu sends out the letter via post.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: Jing Jing questions her ex-boyfriend's sincerity. She receives Yu Tu's letters and reads them. After her performance, she finds Yu Tu waiting to send her back to Yixing to spend the new year.

episodes.title: New Year
episodes.overview: Yu Tu confesses his feelings to Qiao Jing Jing but he is rejected by her since she thinks that he’s not sincere. He fetches her back to Yixing anyway and they spend the new year separately with their own families.

episodes.title: Forgiven
episodes.overview: When Pei Pei asks, Jing Jing doesn't want to talk about Yu Tu, yet she decides to join the class gathering because of him. Upon hearing that Jing Jing will be at the gathering, Yu Tu rushes over for her.

episodes.title: Happy Together
episodes.overview: Qiao Jing Jing and Yu Tu are officially together. Jing Jing wants to hide their relationship from their parents, but when Yu Tu's mom catches him and Jing Jing together by their house, Jing Jing comes up with lies. Yu Tu returns the favor with Jing Jing's parents before he drives her back to Shanghai.

episodes.title: Long Distance Relationship
episodes.overview: Yu Tu stays over at Jing Jing's place. Xiao Zhu and Qiu Ling are surprised to find out that they are officially together. Yu Tu and Jing Jing start their long distance relationship as Jing Jing starts filming out of town.

episodes.title: White Lies
episodes.overview: Qiao Jing Jing returns to Shanghai a day earlier due to a change in her filming schedule. Due to the traffic situation, she goes to Yu Tu's house instead. In order to get Jing Jing to stay over at his house, Yu Tu pretends to play badly at Honor of Kings to delay her.

episodes.title: The Sleepover
episodes.overview: Qiao Jing Jing spends the night at Yu Tu's house, unaware that the house is being watched. The next morning, Yu Tu follows her to a jewelry event and has to disguise himself as part of the staff. Later that night, they are ready to take the next step in their relationship.

episodes.title: Surprise Visit
episodes.overview: Jing Jing goes back to work in the desert, where she has trouble connecting to the Internet. Yu Tu visits her after completing his assignment nearby. Rushing as he has to return to Shanghai on the same day, he gets down to business immediately.

episodes.title: Staying Over
episodes.overview: Jing Jing decides to stay over at Yu Tu's place after the filming ends. She lies that she'll be leaving the next morning, but Yu Tu finds out from Qiu Ling that she's having a break for two months. Then he surprises her with a revamped room.

episodes.title: Meet My Girlfriend
episodes.overview: Guan Zai returns to work, but Yu Tu feels sad about Guan Zai withdrawing from God Finder. Jing Jing convinces him by comparing it to their relationship. Meanwhile, Yu Tu introduces Jing Jing to his colleagues during Guan Zai's welcome dinner.

episodes.title: The Proposal
episodes.overview: Chen Xue invites Jing Jing and Yu Tu over to her place for dinner. Later on, Yu Tu invites Jing Jing to watch him play in a basketball match and takes the chance to officially introduce her to his colleagues. He proposes to her after the match and both of their families start planning for their wedding.

episodes.title: The Dream Wedding
episodes.overview: Jing Jing wants Yu Tu to apply for the institute's group wedding instead of holding one on their own. Yu Tu doesn't agree at first but soon changes his mind after knowing Jing Jing's dream wedding. He makes a formal proposal and proceeds with the romantic group wedding.

episodes.title: Family Visit
episodes.overview: Yu Tu invites Jing Jing to the launch site. Jing Jing knows that Yu Tu doesn't have time for her, so she takes all the other family members of the staff to go sightseeing so that Yu Tu can focus at work. At night, Yu Tu tells Jing Jing about his next task after the launch.

episodes.title: Final Launch
episodes.overview: It is finally the day of the launch of God Finder. People from all over the country gather at the launch site at Wenchang to witness history. With immense tenacity and competence, Yu Tu leads his unit, and along with other units, they execute the mission perfectly.

series.description: A famous celebrity is about to lose her lucrative video game brand deal. Will her former crush help her become a gaming champion – and might this lead them to romance?

series.title: Mouse (Mousetrap) [Hindi]
series.overview: A psychopath's ruthless serial murders have left the entire nation gripped by fear and chaos. An honest, justice-seeking rookie police officer and a veteran detective with a tragic past, face off against the killer. After their encounter with the psychopath, their lives change completely.

episodes.title: The Head Hunter
episodes.overview: Terrifying news of an unsolved serial killing case strikes the country, putting everyone in fear. One day, a family of four visits a camp site just to face a horrible death by this very serial killer, Head Hunter. A boy survives the ambush and later on pinpoints the prime suspect as the killer. Meanwhile, a gene test to verify an unborn fetus for its potential psychopathic characteristics is carried out on Head Hunter’s baby, and the baby’s mother has to make a choice.

episodes.title: Eye for an Eye
episodes.overview: Moo Chi visits the Head Hunter at the prison and tells him that he’ll not only kill the Head Hunter but find his son and make him suffer as he did. Meanwhile, more murder victims are found in a row and the culprit is leaving leads, asking to be noticed. When Ba Reum visits Moojin Prison, he sees the Head Hunter and also witnesses another murder case.

episodes.title: Resurfacing Murder Cases
episodes.overview: Chi Kook has been found at the prison with multiple stab marks all over his body along with a message written in blood. Not long after that, Chi Kook’s watch, a present gifted by Ba Reum and Dong Koo, was retrieved at the grape farm murder site, leading Ba Reum to join Moo Chi for the investigation. Meanwhile, Bong Yi’s grandmother stumbles upon something she should’ve never found out while working as a cleaning lady for Bong Yi’s settlement money.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.overview: After Bong Yi’s grandmother is murdered and a mysterious finger is found at a church, Moo Chi and his team start investigating more thoroughly. Moo Chi feels that something is suspicious about Doctor Sung Yo Han, but he can’t find any evidence yet. A boy suddenly gets kidnapped and Moo Chi gets a call from the kidnapper. He demands Moo Chi to find out the reason why the boy had to be kidnapped before a certain time. Will Moo Chi be able to save the kid?

episodes.title: The Live Broadcast
episodes.overview: An hour-long live broadcast goes on air in hopes to save Han Kook. But Ba Reum sets off to a discreet journey as the rest struggle hard to find out the predator’s motive of murder. During the live broadcast, endless tip-offs and reports from former victims of the predator flood into the broadcast station. The investigation seems to progress in a positive outlook as Moo Chi narrows down the suspects. Will they be able find the murderer in time?

episodes.title: The Donkey and the Goat
episodes.overview: After Moo Won is brutally murdered, Moo Chi gives up on everything and only keeps drinking. While Han Kook is still missing and his life is under threat, the police haven’t found any clues on the culprit. When Moo Chi gets back on his feet and starts investigating Bong Yi’s grandmother’s case, he finds out about Yo Han and his mother.

episodes.title: Memory Loss
episodes.overview: After getting a gunshot wound, Yo Han is in critical condition. Ba Reum gets brain surgery. But after receiving the brain surgery, he suffers from memory loss. After a year, Moo Chi is assigned to a new team that collects and organizes criminal evidence. Ba Reum starts to work for a small precinct. On his first day at work, he accidentally finds a dead body.

episodes.title: Ba-reum's Memories
episodes.overview: Ba Reum’s instinctive intuition helps Moo Chi get closer to the bottom of the mystery behind the knots. But he suffers from the random flashbacks that seem very unfamiliar. While investigating the suspects, Moo Chi and Ba Reum spot a man who stands out from the rest. On the other hand, Kang Duk Soo, who has been released from prison keeps trying to find out where Bong Yi lives.

episodes.title: Ba-reum's Brain
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finds out about a shocking story behind his brain surgery a year ago. He’s tormented by unwanted memories that keep haunting him. Detective Ko is furious at Han Seo Joon’s remark of being saved and being at peace after accepting Christ and decides to kill him himself.

episodes.title: Sung Yo-han in Me
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finds himself acting a lot more violent than before and realizes that it’s getting harder to control himself. He even gets the urge to kill someone. While Ba Reum is terrified that the Yo Han inside him might take him over completely, another murder case occurs that shows the MO of the previous murder cases. If Yo Han wasn’t the culprit of the serial murders, then is the piece of brain transplanted into Ba Reum’s head not of a psychopath?

episodes.title: Kill Him! Kill Her!
episodes.overview: Ba Reum keeps hearing Yo Han’s voice in his head telling him to kill people. The hallucination eventually made him murder Woo Hyung Chul. When he goes to the station to turn himself in, he finds out all the evidence related to his murder is gone, including Woo Hyung Chul’s body. Bong Yi runs into Kang Duk Soo, which makes her anxious. On a rainy day, Kang Duk Soo starts making a move again.

episodes.title: The Yo-han in Ba-reum
episodes.overview: After killing Kang Duk Soo, Ba Reum keeps a close eye on how the investigation rolls out. He tries to keep a foot ahead so his murder stays unveiled. Bong Yi on the other hand, thinks Moo Chi was the killer of Kang and keeps her mouth shut even when she’s being speculated as a suspect.

episodes.title: DNA on the Weapon
episodes.overview: The DNA result found on the weapon that was used to kill Kang Duk Soo confuses Moo Chi. Bong Yi joins Hong Ju’s team and starts investigating the Suseong serial murder case. With Ba Reum, Bong Yi begins to find the link between the Suseong serial murder cases and the Guryeong attempted murder case. At the same time, Moo Chi also looks into one of the inmates’ cases from Moojin Penitentiary.

episodes.title: The Cat Killer
episodes.overview: Ko Nam, a bright and insightful kid finds out about a cat killer around his neighborhood. One day, he promises to share his personal investigation with Bong Yi but unexpectedly goes through an accident. Ba Reum and Moo Chi dig deeper to find out who would’ve done such a heinous act to a little kid.

episodes.title: It Was All Me!
episodes.overview: Ba Reum starts to remember everything and is filled with guilt. When Ba Reum sees Han Kook’s mother desperately looking for her child even after a year, he decides to confess his crimes and clear Yo Han’s name. Meanwhile, Moo Chi notices that Chi Kook is lying and that he reacts strangely sensitive towards Ba Reum.

episodes.title: Was It Really Sung Yo-han?
episodes.overview: Chi Kook’s sudden death shocks everyone and Ba Reum tries to convince Chi Kook’s mom in requesting an autopsy. Meanwhile, Detective Ko starts to doubt that Sung Yo Han was the real killer. He starts to dig deeper into Song Soo Ho’s past.

episodes.title: The Guryeong Family Massacre
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finally remembers what exactly happened to his family. He tries to set a trap to catch the mysterious OZ, and he finds out a secret about Dr. Daniel Lee in the process. Meanwhile, Moo Chi finds the unregistered car the OZ, the murderer who killed Chi Kook, used.

episodes.title: Please, Give Me Some Time
episodes.overview: Moo Chi finds out that Ba Reum was the killer and ferociously charges after him at the station. Moo Chi also suspects Detective Lee being part of the OZ organization and tries to carry out an investigation on the two, but it’s not easy. As flustered as he is, Ba Reum tries to remain calm to buy time until he figures out the killer of Chi Kook.

episodes.title: Kim Joon-sung's Laptop
episodes.overview: Moo Chi and Bong Yi get closer to the truth. In the meantime, Ba Reum tries to find his aunt, the last missing puzzle piece. Sang, who tries to confirm Ba Reum’s alibi, finds something suspicious at Ba Reum’s house.

episodes.title: Ba-reum's Final Call
episodes.overview: Ba Reum makes the final decision to turn himself in and finish one last mission that only he can do. Hong Ju also shares her big secret that’s been tormenting her for years on her last show with Hee Jin, a woman who in fact was a secret agent working for Choi Young Shin under a massive private organization.

series.title: Love in Disguise [Hindi]
series.description: Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is the prime suspect of a shocking murder. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as a male secretary to keep an eye on Yi-jun. The closer they get to what really happened, the closer Yi-jun and Jae-hee become. Will Jae-hee, who is hiding her identity, and Yi-jun, who is hiding a secret, be able to let their true feelings be known to one another?

series.title: Make Me Tingle [Hindi]
series.description: A marketer with traditional views on love and marriage tries to navigate a connection with an adult toy company CEO with different values.

series.title: Take Charge of My Heart [Hindi]
series.description: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

series.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life [Hindi]
series.originalTitle: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life [Hindi]
series.description: Rein spent years enhancing his guildmates’ gear with magic, only to be expelled the moment he enchanted everything. Unfazed, Rein steals back his magic, pours it into his own sword, and makes the best of his newfound freedom as he sets off as an adventurer. Along the way, Rein gathers a band of fellow outcasts and together they fight monsters and carve out their place in an enchanted world.

series.title: Carrie [Hindi]
series.description: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

series.title: Overgeared [Hindi]
series.description: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

series.title: A Love Other Than Yours [Hindi]
series.description: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

series.title: Ali Baba aur 40 Bhoot [Hindi]
series.description: Rooted in logic and science, Alisha is drawn into an experience that defies everything she believes. Will she find answers or uncover a terrifying truth?

series.title: Chumbak [Hindi]
series.description: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

series.title: The Ordinary Jackpot [Hindi]
series.description: An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.

series.title: The Early Spring [Hindi]
series.description: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

series.title: Our Sticky Love [Hindi]
series.description: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

series.title: My Bias, My Boss [Hindi]
series.description: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

series.title: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand [Hindi]
series.originalTitle: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand [Hindi]
series.description: Luck, an S-rank mage in the hero's party, makes a last stand against the Demon King to save his companions. When he finally returns victorious, ten years have passed, and the world praises him as a legendary hero who died in battle. Unable to reclaim his former life, Luck conceals his identity and begins again as "Lock," an F-rank adventurer forging a future in a world that moved on without him.

series.title: BLACK TORCH [Hindi]
series.description: Jiro Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jiro is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Rago, Jiro discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Rago’s powers.

series.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System [Hindi]
series.originalTitle: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System [Hindi]
series.description: Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn's future shatters when he awakens the so-called "defective" Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the "weakest" class.

series.title: Filing for Love [Hindi]
series.description: A romantic comedy about Joo In-ah, a charismatic audit department head with a secret, and Noh Ki-joon, the department's ace who is suddenly demoted to deal with the company's scandals.

series.title: The Ramparts of Ice [Hindi]
series.description: Weighed down by memories she can't shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm's length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.

series.title: Arafta [Hindi]
series.description: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart.

series.title: Dhootha [Hindi]
series.description: Journalist Sagar's life turns thrilling as he unravels dark secrets behind newspaper clippings predicting tragedies. He becomes a murder suspect, racing against time to clear his name and solve the enigma and faces dangerous twists. Suspense builds in this roller-coaster ride.

episodes.title: Episode 1 - The Puzzle
episodes.overview: When Sagar the Chief Editor of ‘Samacharam’ newspaper, finds a crossword puzzle in a dhaba. The puzzle predicts a terrifying incident that would occur in his life.

episodes.title: Episode 2 - Editorial Cartoon
episodes.overview: Police Detective Kranthi Shenoy is given the suicide case of a popular journalist. While investigating she suspects foul play. Ajay Ghosh under Sagar’s instruction, interrogates Koti which leads to more problems.

episodes.title: Episode 3 - Horoscope
episodes.overview: Suicide investigation leads Kranthi to gun smuggling racket which eventually leads to the disappearance of Koti. Koti’s truck being involved in the accident, brings Sagar and Ajay Ghosh into the investigation’s purview. During the launch of ‘Samacharam’s’ first copy, Sagar receives a mysterious message in the form of old newspaper scrap.

episodes.title: Episode 4 - Crime Report
episodes.overview: While Sagar and Ajay Ghosh discuss recent events, they find a clue from the old newspaper scrap which drives their investigation further. Kranti and Ranga discover a connection between the case and Sagar’s farm house. The suspense continues to build.

episodes.title: Episode 5 - Page 3
episodes.overview: As Kranthi and Ranga continue the investigations they find an unexpected dead body. Sagar follows Kiran Reddy, the research head and host for the YouTube show "Ghost Shadows," and learns about Ravi’s research into journalist’s suicide. Sagar gets a newspaper scrap with yet another ominous prediction.

episodes.title: Episode 6 - This Day, That Year
episodes.overview: As Kranthi’s investigative net tightens around Sagar, he decides to visit Dhootha Publications in an attempt to unravel the mystery behind Sathyamurthy’s book. The story delves into a shocking past. With this information Sagar goes to the light house, closing in on the truth.

episodes.title: Episode 7 - Continued on Page 6
episodes.overview: As deaths continue, Sagar is forewarned about an impending danger to his family, he comes clean to Kranthi and together they race against time to stop the newspapers’ deadly prediction.

episodes.title: Episode 8 - Headlines
episodes.overview: Priya becomes the target of a mysterious killer. As the events unfold, Sagar’s past and family secrets comes to light, Kranti begins to connect the dots to uncover the truth.

series.title: Rana Naidu [Hindi]
series.description: Rana Naidu can solve any problem in Bollywood. But when his father is suddenly released from prison, the one mess he can’t handle may be his own.

episodes.title: Episode 1 - He's back
episodes.overview: While burying scandals for cricketers and starlets, Rana Naidu contends with his father’s sudden release from jail. An illicit encounter irks Naina.

episodes.title: Episode 2 - Teen karod
episodes.overview: Naga tries to bond with his family. Rana handles Prince’s latest problem, while a tentative friendship forms between Nitya and her neighbor, Rehaan.

episodes.overview: A car accident leaves OB — and his condition — in a vulnerable position. An unexpected meeting leads Naga to the chilling truth about his son.

episodes.overview: With a plan and agenda of his own, Naga seeks to coax a confession out of Prince. Rana’s deal with Rehaan’s mother suffers a devastating setback.

episodes.title: Episode 5 - Kitna gurda, kitna goo
episodes.overview: Trailed by a dogged cop, Rana takes matters into his own hands. Jaffa is drawn into the darkness when a party at his apartment spirals out of control.

episodes.title: Episode 6 - Bheje ku light, gote ku tight
episodes.overview: Mining his past for a blockbuster film, Prince is forced to recall a harrowing night. Rana returns to Hyderabad in search of a notorious figure.

episodes.title: Episode 7 - Nitya
episodes.overview: Memories of their late sister on her birthday bring the brothers together. A rebellious Nitya seeks out Rehaan in his childhood home.

episodes.title: Episode 8 - Tu kya kiya?
episodes.overview: After asking Prince to accompany Ani to a glamorous award ceremony, Rana’s well-laid plans take a dark turn as Surya finally confronts Naga.

episodes.title: Episode 9 - Maharaj
episodes.overview: Scrambling to keep Jaffa out of trouble, Tej and Rana begin to clash. Confined to a hotel room, Naina’s suspicions reach a boiling point.

episodes.title: Episode 10 - Game over g*ndu
episodes.overview: As news of Surya’s presence in Mumbai spreads, Rana faces pressure to help him escape. Bullets fly in a bloody confrontation where no one is safe.

episodes.title: Episode 1 - One Last Job
episodes.overview: Rana faces a deadly mission to rescue his kidnapped son and must — reluctantly — team up with his estranged father while relying on a wealthy benefactor.

episodes.title: Episode 2 - Bada Kutta
episodes.overview: As an enraged Rana confronts underworld kingpin Rauf in prison, a dissatisfied Naina confides in her new friend, Naveen.

episodes.title: Episode 3 - Well Played, Mr Naidu
episodes.overview: In a tense game of blackmail and manipulation, Rauf pushes Rana to his limit. Family tensions come to a head during Ani's birthday party.

episodes.title: Episode 4 - Kacchaa Limbu Saalaa
episodes.overview: Naga and Tej plan a heist at Oberoi Studios to retrieve a valuable item. Naina gets closer to Naveen, putting more strain on an already stressed Rana.

episodes.title: Episode 5 - It Will Never Be Okay
episodes.overview: After Tej is brutally beaten in prison, Rana knows he must get him out quickly — all while protecting Nitya, who's caught in a deadly shootout.

episodes.title: Episode 6 - Double Dholki
episodes.overview: Deep in Viraj Oberoi's debt, Rana has to clean up after a grisly murder. Meanwhile, Anjali manipulates Naga into taking on a suicidal mission.

episodes.title: Episode 7 - Sumdi Mein Lomdi
episodes.overview: Naveen sees an opportunity to put Rana behind bars. Jaffa and Tasneem's wedding celebrations bring the entire family together — for a fateful event.

episodes.title: Episode 8 - One Last Job, Again
episodes.overview: After a brutal attack puts some of his family in the hospital, Rana finally goes on the offensive against Rauf and his team.
